description: This PHP class 'EndpointList' manages a list of endpoints, differentiating between active and expired endpoints, and provides methods to retrieve or remove endpoints based on their status.

classes.name: EndpointList
classes.description: Manages active and expired endpoints, allowing retrieval and removal of endpoints based on their expiration status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EndpointList with a list of endpoints and prepares it for usage.

methods.name: getActive
methods.description: Retrieves an active, unexpired endpoint if available, otherwise null.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns an active endpoint if available; otherwise attempts to return an expired endpoint, or null if none are available.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an endpoint from both active and expired lists by key.

methods.name: getExpired
methods.description: Retrieves an expired endpoint if available, otherwise null.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Advances the internal pointer of the given array, resetting if at the end.
